Why Polar Endurance

The Polar Endurance
Difference

Four principles sit at the heart of everything we do.

01 - Foundation

Built Around Your Life

You have a career, social life and commitments. Your plan is built around your schedule - efficient, flexible, and designed to deliver results with the time you actually have. We want your training to add to your life, not feel like a chore.

02 - Mindset

Training Should Be Enjoyable

The best training plan is the one you want to do. We build sessions you look forward to, progressions that feel rewarding, and a coaching relationship that keeps you motivated through the hard weeks and energised through the good ones.

03 - Method

Engineering-Precision Training

A background in engineering and a lifetime in endurance sport means we apply real systems thinking to your development. Every training block is designed with purpose - load, adaptation, recovery, and progression calculated with precision. No guesswork. No generic plans.

04 - Longevity

Recovery and Strength

Recovery and strength are not afterthoughts - they are core pillars of every Polar Endurance programme. Optimised recovery supports consistent training. Targeted strength and conditioning keeps you injury-free and performing at your best all year round, alongside effective nutrition guidance.

The Coach
Coached by an engineer.
Guided by science.
Driven by the mountains.

I've taken race wins in Africa and Europe, but my greatest joy has been seeing my athletes succeed. Watching them finish their first marathon brings back those feelings of pure joy that I had in my own running journey. And I love continually learning to see how best I can help every athlete that comes to us.

Polar Endurance was started to continue sharing my love for the outdoors and help others find the coaching they may be missing. Training that respects your life outside of sport, while still helping you surpass all your goals. Something that made training feel like a privilege, not a punishment.

Having been a qualified personal trainer for over 10 years, I then started coaching endurance athletes in 2020 and haven't stopped learning since. The sport has taken me from local road races to the mountains, and every athlete I help makes me both a better coach and athlete.

Qualifications & Credentials

  • Sports Nutrition - HFPA

The Philosophy

Science is the Foundation.
Enjoyment is the Goal.

Every Polar Endurance plan is built on established exercise physiology - and on the understanding that athletes are people first.

Periodisation & Zone Training

Your training year is structured into phases built around your race calendar. We establish your individual training zones through testing, not guesswork - every session has a purpose. Easy days are genuinely easy. Hard days are genuinely hard. This ensures you arrive at key sessions fresh and races rested. It's where most self-coached athletes get it wrong.

Load Management

Training stress and life stress are tracked and managed together. Stress on the body isn't just physical - a difficult week at work, poor sleep, or personal pressure all affect your capacity to train. We monitor acute and chronic load ratios and adjust accordingly. The goal is consistent, progressive overload - not boom and bust.

Sleep & Recovery as Training

Sleep and recovery are not optional extras - they are where the adaptation actually happens. The training stimulus is only half of the equation. Without quality sleep, structured recovery, and proper nutrition timing, even the best training plan fails to deliver. At Polar Endurance, we treat rest with the same rigour as the hardest session of the week, because without it, the hard sessions don't count.

The Human Element

Data without context is just numbers. The athlete in front of me is a person with a job, a family, good weeks and hard weeks. My job is to build a programme that works in the real world - not just on paper. Training should never become a chore. If you're dreading your sessions, something is wrong. Building training you want to do, for every single athlete, is a skill we take seriously.
